title: Completed REQUIREMENTS MANAGEMENT PLAN Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed REQUIREMENTS MANAGEMENT PLAN artifact data payloads (PMO-04.02.02).

requirements_elicitation_techniques.description: Methods used to gather stakeholder needs including interviews, focus groups, and surveys.

requirements_analysis_and_elaboration.description: Analytical processes applied to structure, clarify, and model requirements.

stakeholder_engagement_for_requirements.description: Strategy for maintaining active stakeholder participation throughout requirements definition.

requirements_taxonomy_and_categories.description: Classification scheme covering business, stakeholder, solution, functional, and non-functional requirements.

requirements_documentation_standards.description: Formatting guidelines and documentation artifacts used to record verified requirements.

requirements_prioritization_scheme.description: Ranking methodology (such as MoSCoW, weighted scoring, or value ranking) to prioritize scope.

requirements_product_metrics.description: Quantitative metrics measuring requirements volatility, defect density, and coverage.

traceability_structure_and_attributes.description: Attributes and linkages tracked across the requirements lifecycle to ensure bidirectional traceability.

requirements_configuration_control.description: Procedures for baseline versioning and evaluating changes to documented requirements.

requirements_verification_method.description: Techniques ensuring requirements are complete, consistent, unambiguous, and testable.

validation_and_user_acceptance_strategy.description: Approach for validating that final deliverables fulfill underlying business objectives.
